title.heading:
First
programming
title.text:
Panel and IOmcu over USB.
Later updates from GitHub and over Wi-Fi.

labels.title: The panel from the back
labels.text: The 7 inch ESP32-P4 display board. Either USB-C socket takes the cable.

say.text: This video shows how to load the firmware onto a new R C bench with the R B mod carrier: the panel from a browser, the I O M C U from a U S B drive. Then it shows the two ways to update later: from GitHub, and from a browser over Wi-Fi.
Step 1. Download three files from the releases page on GitHub: the panel's zip file, the zip file of the I O M C U for the R B mod carrier, and the checksum file.
Unpack both zip files. Two files in them are needed: the merged panel image, and the install image of the I O M C U.
Step 2. The panel. Connect one of the panel's two U S B C sockets to a computer.
Open the E-S-P web tool by Spacehuhn in Chrome or Edge.
Click Connect and pick the panel's serial port.
Add the merged panel image and leave its address at zero.
Click Program. When the tool reports the end, the panel holds its firmware and starts on its default settings.

body.p: 1. Click on Connect   2. Select the port   3. Add the .bin and set the address   4. Click Program

body.dialog: esptool.spacehuhn.com wants to connect to a serial port

rows.text: USB serial port of the panel

labels.title: RP2350-CAN on the rbmod carrier
labels.text: The IOmcu drives every output. Its USB-C socket is at the module's end.

labels.title: Hold BOOT, plug in
labels.text: Hold BOOT while the USB cable goes in. Release it once the cable is in.

labels.title: USB once, CAN afterwards
labels.text: The partition table gives the IOmcu two slots. The panel writes the slot that is not running.

say.text: Step 3. The I O M C U. It is the R P 23 50 module on the carrier.
Hold the boot button on the module, plug its U S B C socket into the computer, then let go.
The computer shows a drive named R P 23 50.
Copy the install image onto the drive. The module restarts by itself and runs the firmware.
The install image also writes a partition table. With it, every later update comes from the panel over the CAN bus.

card.title: First start
card.text: Power both boards with the link wired.

steps.title: The start-up check
steps.text: LINK OK and IOMCU OK: both boards run and talk at 1 Mbit/s.
steps.say: The start-up check lists board, display, touch, storage and settings. Link OK and I O M C U OK mean that both boards run and talk to each other.

steps.title: The carrier's outputs
steps.text: SETUP > OUTPUTS shows the pins of the rbmod carrier.
steps.say: Setup, outputs shows the pins of the R B mod carrier. The bench is ready to use.

card.title: Updates from GitHub
card.text: The panel downloads a release and installs it.

steps.title: A home network, once
steps.text: CHOOSE HOME NETWORK scans for WPA2 and WPA3 networks.
steps.say: The panel needs a home network, once. Open setup, Wi-Fi, and tap choose home network.

steps.title: Pick the network
steps.text: Up to 16 networks, strongest first.
steps.say: The panel lists the networks it finds. Tap yours.

steps.title: Type the password
steps.text: 8 to 63 characters. The panel joins the network and keeps it.
steps.say: Type its password. The panel joins the network and keeps it.

steps.title: CHECK FOR UPDATES
steps.text: The check needs the bench SAFE and the supply output off.
steps.say: Open setup, updates, and tap check for updates. The bench has to be safe, with the supply output off.

steps.title: The panel asks GitHub
steps.text: Wi-Fi goes on for the check and off again.
steps.say: The panel switches Wi-Fi on and asks GitHub for the newest release.

steps.title: Step 1: PANEL
steps.text: A newer release is offered with a 2 s hold.
steps.say: A newer release makes step 1, panel, the current step. Hold the button for 2 seconds to download and install.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: The firmware is checked before a byte is written.
steps.say: The panel downloads the firmware and checks it before it writes anything.

steps.title: Writing
steps.text: The firmware goes into the slot that is not running.
steps.say: It writes the firmware into the slot that is not running. Leave the panel switched on.

steps.title: Written and checked
steps.text: The panel restarts into the new version.
steps.say: The firmware is read back and checked. Then the panel restarts into the new version.

steps.title: Step 2: IOMCU
steps.text: The panel carries the IOmcu's firmware.
steps.say: After the restart, updates opens on step 2. The panel carries the firmware of the I O M C U. Hold the button for 2 seconds.

steps.title: Over the CAN bus
steps.text: Outputs stay off until the update ends.
steps.say: The panel sends the firmware over the CAN bus. The outputs stay off until the update ends.

steps.title: Step 3: C6 RADIO
steps.text: The ESP32-C6 carries Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
steps.say: Step 3 updates the panel's radio, the E S P 32 C 6, with the same hold. The panel restarts after it.

steps.title: Up to date
steps.text: With the reminder on, the panel checks GitHub at each start.
steps.say: With every step current, the bench is up to date. With the reminder on, the panel checks GitHub at each start.

card.title: Update from a browser
card.text: The panel opens its own network and takes a file.

steps.title: ACCESS POINT
steps.text: The panel opens its own WPA2 network.
steps.say: The second way needs no home network. Open setup, Wi-Fi, and tap access point.

steps.title: Join and open the page
steps.text: Network, password, address and access code are on the screen.
steps.say: The screen shows a network name, a password, an address and an access code. Join the network with a phone or a computer and open the address.

steps.title: Upload the panel file
steps.text: rcbench-panel-p4-vX.Y.Z.bin, the release's file for updates.
steps.say: Enter the access code. Under panel firmware, pick the release's panel file that ends in dot bin, and tap upload.

steps.title: INSTALL PANEL FIRMWARE?
steps.text: The installation starts on the panel only.
steps.say: The panel checks the file and shows both versions. Hold install for 2 seconds. Only this hold on the panel starts the installation.

steps.title: Writing
steps.text: Written, read back, checked, restarted.
steps.say: The panel writes the firmware, checks it and restarts.

steps.title: Then the IOmcu
steps.text: The band names the next step.
steps.say: The update of the I O M C U follows on updates, as before.

scenes.heading: Firmware loaded
items: Panel: ESP Web Tool, merged image at 0x0
IOmcu: hold BOOT, copy the install image to RP2350
First start: LINK OK, IOMCU OK
Or: WI-FI › ACCESS POINT, upload, 2 s hold
scenes.say: Both boards are loaded. From here on, the bench updates itself from GitHub, or takes a file from a browser.
